text:
matt.s: seeing pages not reach the on-call since ~12:01 UTC, alerts show delivered on our side but oncall didn't get SMS. anyone else?
carla: yep same. incidentbot shows retries > 5 for notify-connector and then 'suppressed' delivery.
ben: logs from gateway look like 401/403 from pager vendor, then a TTL/ token error in the header chain. grabbing stacktrace now.
incidentbot: Alert INC-2026: notify-connector webhook retries exhausted (x6); automatic paging suppressed.
carla: pasted log: ```
2026-06-04T12:01:05Z notify-connector ERROR webhook POST https://pager.example/api/ack 401 Unauthorized token_expired
2026-06-04T12:01:06Z notify-connector WARN retrying (attempt 4)
2026-06-04T12:04:10Z notify-connector ERROR retries exhausted, suppressing page
```
matt.s: that matches what I saw — signing token TTL rotated early for the vendor key. suspect our key-sync job didn't rotate the cached secret.
lina: i'm on infra — can flip the fallback relay to legacy-sms now (manual path). command: `kubectl -n notify set env deploy/notify-connector RELAY=legacy-sms && kubectl rollout restart deploy/notify-connector`
oncall-sre: i'm oncall, received a manual slack ping from matt but no SMS. please switch to legacy, i'll confirm SMS once live.
carla: matt, can you confirm the key-sync job status? `kubectl get jobs key-sync -n infra`
matt.s: job shows COMPLETED but last run at 03:00 UTC, our vendor rotated at 11:58 UTC — key-sync didn't pick new rotation. looks like a parsing bug in rotation webhook.
ben: pushing a quick hotfix to ignore empty rotation metadata, PR linked: https://git.internal/r/notify/1234
deploy-bot: matt.s deployed notify-connector@hotfix-20260604 (sha: abcd1234) to staging at 12:12 UTC
lina: legacy relay env flipped. rolling restart kicked off.
oncall-sre: SMS started arriving at 12:16 UTC. I confirm on-call received pages. :white_check_mark:
matt.s: thanks — leaving legacy relay enabled while we fully validate key-sync fix.
carla: can we triage customer impact? which customers had suppressed pages?
ben: temporary window ~12:01-12:16 UTC. picking affected alerts from datastore, looks like 22 customer pages suppressed, 3 paid customers with high-severity impacts (support ops notified).
oncall-sre: I opened incident ticket assigned to SRE and alerted CSM for the 3 customers.
matt.s: next steps: 1) rollback not needed (hotfix deployed), 2) reopen key-sync webhook parsing PR and add unit that covers vendor payloads, 3) postmortem + customer comms. I'll own the retro.
carla: also add an alert for vendor-token-age > 5m after rotation to catch future drift.
lina: putting that rule in now. `rules: - name: vendor-token-age ...`
incidentbot: NOTE: automatic paging will resume once notify-connector reports healthy and no suppressed alerts pending.
matt.s: last check — notify-connector healthy, no suppressed alerts pending, SMS confirmed. marking incident as mitigated.
ben: creating postmortem draft in #postmortems and will ping eng-sre for review.
oncall-sre: thanks team — good coordination. we'll follow up with customer comms template in #support. :thumbsup:
